go service, memory climbs slowly till OOM around day 2. pprof shows lots of time.Timer and goroutines parked in select with a time.After in a loop. where do I look?

time.After allocates a timer that isn't collected until it fires, so a loop calling it each iteration piles up timers. Replace it with a single time.NewTimer that you Reset, or use context deadlines, and Stop it on exit.

turns: 16 node training run, NCCL all-reduce hangs after several thousand steps, IB error 12 on one rank, symbol errors on one leaf port. what do I do?
Start with the physical layer: reseat or replace the cable/transceiver on that port, drain the node pair, then set NCCL_IB_TIMEOUT and a watchdog so the job aborts instead of hanging.
